messages:
incident-bot: :rotating_light: ALERT: Sudden spike in 502/504 at api-gateway-prod (edge). 1m error rate = 18% (baseline ~0.3%). Affected routes: /v1/generate, /v1/embeddings. Grafana: https://grafana.redwood/g/dash/edge-gateway?panelId=12

sara: I'm on call. looking at graphs now. first glance: spike at 12:41 UTC, coincides with a deploy window?

devon: nobody scheduled a deploy at 12:40, checked deploy-bot and github actions.

liam: can someone run a quick curl against the gateway to reproduce? I'll tail envoy logs.

sara: reproducing locally: `curl -i -X POST https://api.redwood.prod/v1/generate -d '{"prompt":"hi"}'` -> 504 after ~30s.

liam: tails from envoy (snippet):
```
[2026-03-14T12:41:13Z] envoy rtr: upstream reset: connection reset by peer, code 0
[2026-03-14T12:41:14Z] envoy rtr: upstream response timeout
[2026-03-14T12:41:15Z] envoy rtr: 502 Bad Gateway from upstream pool model-pool-us-east
```

marco: interesting — upstream pool `model-pool-us-east` is showing increased connection failures. checking k8s pods and node CPU.

devon: I see a flurry of 502s in the gateway access logs with backend host x.x.x.108 and a lot of `connection reset` messages.

sara: important: CS reports a cluster of customers seeing failed calls; CS assigned @cs-rep and is posting updates in customer-impact.

oncall-bot: @sara You have been paged (incident priority P1). Please acknowledge.

sara: ack. declaring incident. Triage owner = sara. Can someone escalate to infra if nodes are unhealthy?

liam: k8s shows some pods in model-pool-us-east cycling CrashLoopBackOff ~12:40. Root cause maybe a JVM OOM in the model server after a config change.

devon: rollback candidate: we pushed runtime config `max-connections` bump to 4k at 12:39. If that caused more concurrency than model servers expected they might be exhausting file descriptors or memory. Any config commits around that time?

marco: yep that config change came from `infra/runtime-config` PR merged at 12:38. I can revert via `kubectl apply -f previous-config.yaml` to restore safe defaults.

sara: plan: 1) add temporary gateway fallback to older model variant to reduce pressure 2) revert runtime-config or scale model-pool nodes 3) communicate to CS with ETA. Who can flip the gateway routing?

liam: I can add a routing override in the control-plane to steer traffic away from model-pool-us-east to model-pool-us-west by updating route table `gateway-routes/primary`:
```
kubectl patch configmap gateway-routes -n infra --type merge -p '{"data":{"primary":"model-pool-us-west"}}'
```
I'll do that in 2m.

devon: meanwhile I'll open a rollback PR for the runtime-config and post the command to apply. If rollback doesn't help, we scale the pool up.

sara: CS update (for recording): "We are investigating elevated 50x errors for API calls. Engineers are triaging and implementing a temporary routing mitigation. Next update in 10 minutes."

marco: routing patch applied. Traffic shifted. Monitoring looks better: 1m error rate dropped to 4% and dropping. Latencies also recovering.

liam: model-pool-us-east pods remain unhealthy; logs show repeated `OutOfMemoryError` in `model-server` process. Suspect the new `max-connections` allowed the server to accept too many sessions and memory ballooned.

devon: rollback applied and restarted model-server daemonset on affected nodes. Restart sequence in progress.

sara: good containment. Next steps: postmortem owner = sara + marco. Actions: revert config permanently until we safety-test, add memory limits and a connection throttling guard on model-server, add alert for sudden per-upstream OOMs, and refine runbook for edge 502/504 spikes.

cs-rep: forwarding update to customers: "Mitigation in place; traffic rerouted and services recovering. We expect reduced errors within 15 minutes."

incident-bot: Incident transitioned to mitigation (status: partial-service-degradation). Timeline start=1768501234

sara: wrapping up on-call handoff: devon will take follow-up this shift (postmortem + hardening). I'm off in 30m, will handoff any remaining tasks to devon.

devon: taking postmortem ownership. I'll bundle logs, commits, and timeline.

sara: thanks all. Good work. :thumbsup:
